findings.passage: “It is extremely important to the citizens of Wisconsin that our elections are fair and transparent,” said Representative Dallman. “Voting in the United States is a constitutional right and we must do everything in our power to protect that.”
findings.note: Press release issued by his office after the Assembly passed an election bill package. The release says the package includes requiring all indefinitely confined voters to provide identification, and added checks to prevent non-citizens from voting. This quote is his general statement on the package. Passage copied from the PDF text via pdftotext of the downloaded file.

findings.passage: “Restoring trust in our elections is of the utmost importance and I am happy to see more progress being made in that area today,” said Representative Dallman.
findings.note: Second quote in the same press release, about the same election bill package (including ID for indefinitely confined voters and non-citizen voting checks, and a constitutional amendment limiting voting to citizens).
